Name: Anime Portrait for Victor -Seasonal
Author: vickylchq
Description:
[size=3]更新：本美化目前被额外整合到了[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482](CP) Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits[/url]中，也可以下载它（如果你还想拥有其他SVE角色的肖像美化的话）
Update: This mod has been integrated into [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30482](CP) Donut's SVE Seasonal Anime Portraits﻿[/url]﻿ now, which can also be downloaded (if you want more portraits for NPCs from SVE)

----------

在[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25975]Anime Portrait for Victor[/url][size=3]的基础上，参考[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url][size=3]，为维克多绘制了新的肖像。[/size]
[size=3]包括：春季，秋季，冬季室内，花舞节，万灵节[/size][i]
New portraits of Victor based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25975]Anime Portrait for Victor[/url]﻿, referencing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url].
Includes: Spring, Fall, Winter Indoor, Flower Dance, Spirits Eve[/i]


[size=5][b]！！！注意！！！[/b]
必须搭配上述两mod，才能拥有全部的维克多季节肖像！[i][b]
!!! ATTENTION !!![/b]
Must be paired with the two mods above to have the full Victor seasonal portrait![/i][/size]


[size=3]使用方法：[/size]
[size=3]1. 确保你已下载[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]
[size=3]2. 确保你已下载[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25975]Anime Portrait for Victor[/url][size=3]﻿，并提取出其中的png文件（它们在assets文件夹中）[/size]
[size=3]3. 下载本mod，并提取出其中的png文件（其实这就是压缩包内的全部了）[/size]
[size=3]4. 将全部png文件（共8个）都放入[CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE\assets\Portraits\Victor，选择覆盖（可以提前备份）[/size]
[size=3]5. 完成！[/size]
[i]Usage:
1. make sure you have downloaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url].
2. make sure you have downloaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25975]Anime Portrait for Victor[/url]﻿ and extract the png files from it (they are in assets folder).
3. download the mod and extract the png files (all contents in the zip).
4. put all the png files (8 in total) into [[u]CP] Seasonal Cute Characters SVE\assets\Portraits\Victor[/u] and choose to overwrite them (you can back them up in advance).
5. Finish![/i]
